title: Cloudflare shows cf-cache-status DYNAMIC and never caches HTML or JSON responses
symptoms: cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC on every HTML page
Origin load does not drop after enabling the proxy
API JSON responses with long Cache-Control still hit the origin
cause: Cloudflare caches by file extension, and HTML and JSON are not on the default list. Responses that carry Set-Cookie are also never cached.
fix: Add a Cache Rule that marks the paths as eligible for cache, and stop sending Set-Cookie on public pages.
apply:
Cloudflare dashboard > your zone > Caching > Cache Rules > Create rule
If: Hostname equals example.com and URI Path starts with /blog
Then: Cache eligibility = Eligible for cache; Edge TTL = Use cache-control header if present
affected: All Cloudflare plans, default cache behavior as of October 2026
